title: Digital, AI and robotics
detail: Employers across every priority sector want staff who can use automation, robotics and AI-supported systems, from everyday digital confidence to advanced skills like robotics maintenance and data-driven decision-making.

title: Net zero and low carbon skills
detail: Net zero content, such as heat pump installation and solar PV, is being built into existing courses across construction, energy, land-based and other sectors rather than taught as a separate subject.

title: Rurality and transport
detail: Cumbria's rural geography and limited public transport make it harder for young people to reach jobs, training and colleges, with 58% of residents commuting by car.

title: NEET reduction and inclusion
detail: Cumbria wants a joined-up, countywide strategy to reduce the number of 17-24 year olds not in education, employment or training, and to remove barriers facing disabled people, care leavers and other disadvantaged groups.

title: Professional and business services
detail: A review of accountancy and other professional services roles is planned, to spot skills gaps beyond the six priority sectors.

title: Apprenticeship growth
detail: There's a drive to reverse a recent decline in 16-18 apprenticeship starts and make apprenticeships easier for small employers to offer and for learners to complete.
